Peripheral device management(1 mark)
___________________________________________________________________________

items.stem:
Kevin installed a third-party firewall software on his computer.
(a)
It is not necessary for most users to install a separate, third-party firewall software. Why?
(1 mark)
_______________________________________________________________________________
(b)
Kevin also installed a separate backup software to backup his computer regularly.
(i)
He thinks since his computer has a 1TB drive, the hard drive used to store his backup must be 1TB in capacity.
Explain why this is not necessarily true.(1 mark)_
___________________________________________________________________________
(ii)
He realises that he can set different backup intervals, for example backup “once every day” or “once every two week”.
Give an advantage for a shorter interval and a longer interval respectively.(2 marks)
___________________________________________________________________________
___________________________________________________________________________
[--Answer:
(a) Most operating systems already provide a built-in firewall.
(b)(i) Not all files on the system drive are backed up / The backup can be compressed in file size
(b)(ii) Shorter interval: Recently created files are safe in the backup
Longer interval: Less computing resources needed / Problematic files created recently are not included in the backup
--]

Cody bought a new printer.
(a)
He needs to install a driver before using it.
What is the purpose of a driver program?(1 mark)
_______________________________________________________________________________
(b)
Explain why it is necessary to update driver programs when updates are available.(1 mark)
_______________________________________________________________________________
(c)
Some operating systems can identify a new hardware when plugged in, and search for the suitable driver from a database and install it automatically.
Compared to the user manually downloading and installing the driver, give an advantage and a disadvantage of this approach.(2 marks)
_______________________________________________________________________________
_______________________________________________________________________________
[--Answer:
(a) Driver programs are used to control peripheral devices by translating requests into machine level commands.
(b) Fix bugs / Fix security vulnerabilities / Maintain compatibility with new hardware and software
(c) Advantage: More convenient / Less prone to the human error of installing the wrong driver
Disadvantage: The driver in the database may be outdated / Cannot choose between the drivers available
--]

items.stem:
For each of the following software, give a real-life example of why it should be classified as the given mode of operation.
(a)
Supermarket inventory management, Multi-user system(2 marks)
_______________________________________________________________________________
(b)
Disk defragmentation software, batch processing system(2 marks)
_______________________________________________________________________________
(c)
Video call software, Real time processing system(2 marks)_______________________________________________________________________________
[--Answer:
(a) It must allow point-of-sale from different branches to update the inventory database at the same time while maintaining data consistency across all users.
(b) Disk defragmentation can be set to perform at a fixed interval, such as every night or every week.
(c) Video call software has to display the video input from a user instantly as the display output on the other user’s device.
--]
Long QuestionsSSICTB0103_04A001E, 12
Janice is looking at different computer software.
(a)
An advertisement for a disk defragmentation software claims it can improve the overall user experience.
(i)
With reference to how files are stored on a hard drive, explain how disk defragmentation software can improve the overall user experience.(3 marks)
___________________________________________________________________________
___________________________________________________________________________
___________________________________________________________________________
(ii)
Suggest why using disk defragmentation on a new computer system drive would not result in much performance gain.(1 mark)
___________________________________________________________________________
(b)
Janice found that she cannot terminate the file manager process on her computer’s operating system. Give a reason why the file manager cannot be user-terminated. (1 mark)
_______________________________________________________________________________
(c)
The system drive on Janice’ computer reported it is full.
Suggest two ways to free up space on her system drive.(2 marks)
_______________________________________________________________________________
_______________________________________________________________________________
(d)
The operating system prompts Janice to restart her computer for an update whenever it is available. Give two reasons why keeping the operating system up to date is important.(2 marks)_______________________________________________________________________________
(e)
When visiting Kaley’s home, Janice connected to Kaley’s printer using wireless connection.
She found that even though that was her first time connecting to Kaley’s printer, and she didn’t install any driver after connecting, she could still use the printer.
(i)
Explain why a driver program is needed for using the printer.(1 mark)
___________________________________________________________________________
(ii)
Suggest two possible reasons why Janice does not need to install the driver program herself.(2 marks)
___________________________________________________________________________
[--Answer:
(a)(i) Files are stored as separate fragments on different segments on a hard drive.
Disk defragmentation moves fragments of the same file to closer locations on a hard drive.
This reduces overall file access time and results in smoother user experience.
(a)(ii) Most computer files stored on a new computer drive are stored as continuous fragments. / There is not much fragmentation of files across the hard drive.
(b) The file manager is used by other parts of the operating system.(c) Delete unused files / Delete cache / Compress infrequently used files
(d) Fix security vulnerabilities / Maintain compatibility
(e)(i) A driver program is needed for the operating system to communicate with the external device.
(e)(ii) Janice installed the driver for the same printer before. / The operating system installed the driver automatically.
--]

items.stem:
Summie is installing an operating system on her computer.
(a)
State four functions of an operating system. (4 marks)
_______________________________________________________________________________
_______________________________________________________________________________
_______________________________________________________________________________
_______________________________________________________________________________
(b)
Describe the difference between an application program and a utility program.(2 marks)
_______________________________________________________________________________
(c)
Summie thinks that a single-user operating system can only have one user account.With reference to the definition of single-user operating system, explain why she is wrong.
(2 marks)
_______________________________________________________________________________
(d)
Explain why it is unnecessary to install a multi-user operating system on most personal computers.(1 mark)
_______________________________________________________________________________
(e)
Suggest an example where a multi-user operating system would be necessary.(1 mark)
_______________________________________________________________________________
(f)
Describe the following mode of operation with a real life example.
(i)
Batch processing mode(2 marks)
___________________________________________________________________________
(ii)
Parallel processing(2 marks)
___________________________________________________________________________
[--Answer:
(a)File Management / Memory Management / Peripheral device management / Process Management / Disk management / User management / Multitasking
(b)An application achieves a specific task for the user, while a utility program maintains a computer and improves its efficiency.
(c)A single user system only allows one user to access the operating system at the same time. More than one user account can be created.
(d)Most personal computers will not be accessed by two users at the same time.
(e)A supermarket where different points of sale need to access the database concurrently for making sales.
(f)(i) A batch processing system collects data without immediately processing it. Instead, data is processed in a batch at regular intervals. For example, backup software creates a backup regularly.
(f)(ii) A parallel processing system usually consists of multiple processors and memory can be shared among these processors.  For instance, in a system for scientific analysis, data sets can be allocated to different processors for processing.
--]
